profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Sphere
profile.summary: A highly motivated and experienced .NET Full Stack developer with experience in the latest cloud infrastructures. Graduate from UC Irvine with B.S. in Computer Game Science. Developed back-end architectures and experienced in leading teams in an AGILE environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained legacy .NET 4.5 business applications. 
- Collaborated with an Agile team to design a new .NET Core microservices-based software suite on Azure with SQL Server (MSSQL). 
- Contributed to an analytics dashboard using Node.js and React. 
- Built Python tooling and Windows installers (WiX, NSIS), and created Azure Build Pipelines to automate packaging and deployment. 
- Designed and built Azure Function Apps to orchestrate build pipelines and publish installer artifacts. 
- Supported EMV testing and certification efforts. 
- Co-developed an Azure Web PubSub solution connecting client payment devices to the server backend, processing 1M+ transactions per month. 
- Led technical design and built an Azure DevOps automation pipeline enabling QA engineers to validate platform software via desktop automation. 
- Moved to an internal team supporting local/private cloud infrastructure, learning development in Debian, virtualization/VM workflows, Perl/Python scripting, and backend development with PHP and PostgreSQL.

positions.title: Lead Software Developer
positions.description:
-Managed a team of developers to plan and develop software solutions for business strategies using the .NET stack. 
-Developed cloud-based software infrastructure using Microsoft Azure and AWS and provided software tools to various teams in the company.
-Developed an Android Unity scanning software and management platform for supply chain.
-Worked closely with UI/UX designers to create software user flow.
-Developed platforms that connected with many 3rd party API such as eBay, Shopify, Amazon, and Shipstation. 
-Worked on algorithms to provide forecasting and suggestions for search improvements.
-Designed and managed scale-able relational databases.

positions.title: Backend Architect, Game Developer, & Web Programmer
positions.description:
•	Developed and published several children mobile games for iOS and Android
•	Worked closely with artists and animators to achieve highly polished products
•	Developed a NoSQL backend for early games using DocumentDB on Azure
•	Developed Kadho’s backend infrastructure for games on Amazon Web Services
•	Backend RESTful services programmed in C# Web Api 2, with Memcached and MySQL databases
•	Developed backend to work in China, and globally, and to be scalable with load balancers
•	Set up email systems, JIRA, and GitLab, and managed servers
•	Developed interactive websites on AngluarJS with dynamic view support for mobile, tablet, and desktop
•	Worked with big data and set up Elasticsearch and Kibana to create useful data for analysis

positions.title: Student Web Developer
positions.description:
•ASP.NET MVC and MSSQL, and expanded knowledge on ASP.NET Webforms.
•Developed utility websites for campus departments and staff web pages.
•Fixed numerous bugs with existing websites under DUE-IT jurisdiction

projects.title: Dark Current
projects.description:
Dark Current is a game I am developing with for my senior design project at UC Irvine. 
 It is a top-down, 2D action game where you play as a mystical fish fighting against a mysterious darkness that is taking over your home. As you explore the environment and defeat enemies, your character becomes stronger and you learn new abilities. The game is a combination of an arcade shooter and a Metroid-style exploration game, which is unique in today’s market. 

Dark Current won 2nd place at GameSig 2014.

projects.title: Heart Race
projects.description:
HeartRace is a game developed for VGDC's Spring 2013 "AHA" Game Jam and is currently under development. ("AHA" is short for American Heart Association). The initial stage consisted of a 72 hour jam, and the winning team continues creating their game and with the support of the American Heart Association. HeartRace won the game jam after a long night of having our games reviewed by a handful of judges.

HeartRace won the special recognition award at GameSig 2014 for its unique style and concept.
